title: Data & Utility Management
summary: This module provides comprehensive tools for managing datasets, including loading, processing, and specialized task datasets. It also offers general-purpose utilities for file operations, asynchronous execution, callback handling, and documentation generation.

nodes.label: Manage DSPy Datasets
nodes.title: DSPy Dataset Management
nodes.description: Handles loading, processing, and managing various datasets for DSPy programs, including specialized task datasets and utilities for data splitting and sampling.

nodes.label: Provide General Utilities
nodes.title: General DSPy Utilities
nodes.description: Offers a collection of general-purpose utilities for file downloading, asynchronous program execution, callback management, and adapting async modules for synchronous use.

nodes.label: Generate Documentation
nodes.title: Documentation Generation Tools
nodes.description: Provides tools for generating and enhancing documentation, including API reference creation, MkDocs navigation updates, client-side Markdown copy features, and synthetic data generation for tutorials.

nodes.label: DSPy Program
nodes.title: User DSPy Program
nodes.description: The main DSPy application logic that utilizes datasets and general utilities for its operations.

nodes.label: External Data Sources
nodes.title: Data Repositories
nodes.description: Represents various external origins like HuggingFace, local files, or databases from which datasets are loaded.

nodes.label: External Web Services
nodes.title: Web Resources
nodes.description: External web endpoints or services used for downloading files or other general utility functions.

nodes.label: Documentation Platform
nodes.title: MkDocs & Browser
nodes.description: The static site generator (MkDocs) and user's web browser where documentation is rendered and interacted with.

groups.label: Data Management
groups.title: DSPy Data Management

groups.label: Core Utilities
groups.title: General DSPy Utilities

groups.label: Documentation Support
groups.title: Documentation Generation & Enhancement
groups.description: Tools dedicated to generating and enhancing documentation, including API reference creation, MkDocs navigation updates, and client-side features for improved user experience.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Systems & Consumers
groups.description: Represents external systems and consumers that interact with the data and utility modules, such as DSPy programs, data repositories, web services, and documentation platforms.
